info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Development Environment Management API
info.description: The Development Environment Management API facilitates the creation and configuration of development environments essential for IT management within the banking sector. This API allows users to set up new environments tailored to their project needs, enabling efficient testing and deployment workflows. Typical consumers include development teams and IT managers aiming to streamline environment provisioning. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their productivity and maintain robust development practices.

post.summary: Create a new development environment for IT management.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new development environment within the IT management system. Ensure all required parameters are provided for successful creation.
